criterion.text: HOOD (device v2, the product configuration), every condition C0-C6: retake rate <= 5 %, F1 >= F1(C0, hood) - 0.05, verdict agreement with C0 (hood) >= 95 % and 0 silent failures. OPEN (handheld without the hood): 0 silent failures in every condition; retakes allowed and reported per condition with the main gate reason. SSIM is against C0 of the same device.

rule.mad: mean |grid - grid_C0| over the plate, RGB, 8-bit DN, accepted captures
rule.silent: gate not RETAKE and verdict != ground-truth verdict

results.summary: Old method (one auto-exposed frame through the ISP): FAIL.
